name: Druid Sunsoul
body:
Sunsoul druids view the sun as one of the most important natural wonders on the planet—without sunlight, plant life ceases to flourish and photosynthesize, depleting the planet of oxygen to breathe.

A sunsoul has the following class features.

Sun Magic (Sp)

At 1st level, a sunsoul can cast the spells from the cleric sun domain once each per day as a spell-like ability as soon as she is capable of casting spells of the designated levels.

This replaces wild empathy, trackless step, and timeless body.

Fiery Touch (Su)

At 4th level, a sunsoul gains Resist fire 5.

Additionally, a sunsoul can make a melee touch attack that deals 1d4 points of fire damage per druid level. A sunsoul can make a fiery touch attack a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Wisdom modifier.

This replaces resist nature’s lure and a thousand faces.
